visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set at night on an outdoor athletic track with a reddish surface. A young man with dark, slightly curly hair, wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt with the word 'PIZZA' printed on the chest and a black backpack, stands facing the camera. An interviewer's hand holds a microphone with a yellow and blue 'HahaTai' logo towards him. (2) The camera maintains a medium shot of the young man as he speaks and gestures. Large yellow and blue text overlays appear at the bottom and top right of the screen. The background shows blurred lights and the dark outline of a stadium or building structure under night lighting. (3) A brief cutaway shows a stage performance with a large group of people in traditional-style clothing under bright purple and blue stage lights. Two large banners with 'AUCKLAND NEW ZEALAND' are visible on either side of the stage. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor setting with bright, warm lighting. A middle-aged man with glasses, wearing a blue striped shirt and a tan jacket, is being interviewed. Behind him is a large red Daruma doll and metal shelving units filled with various items. He speaks with animated facial expressions and hand movements. (5) The camera captures close-up shots of the middle-aged man as he laughs and points. The 'HahaTai' microphone remains in the frame. Yellow captions and graphical emphasis marks appear around his head during humorous moments.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台 HahaTai. [Subtitle]: 我們也在六龜高中其他同學口中. (2) [Subtitle]: 打聽到了六龜的另一個特色. (3) [Subtitle]: 朋友要來六龜的話你會帶他去哪裡. (4) [Subtitle]: 聽我們的合唱團啊 六龜這邊有尼布恩合唱團. (5) [Subtitle]: 他是一個牙醫師. (6) [Subtitle]: 他本來是來這邊偏鄉服務 也發現就是這邊的人喜歡唱歌. (7) [Subtitle]: 建立了尼布恩合唱團. (8) [Subtitle]: 合唱團裡面有沒有什麼印象深刻的事情. (9) [Subtitle]: 就是2023年時候我們去韓國 然後去年時候去紐西蘭. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們去比世界合唱大賽 就是都拿金牌. [Variety]: 嗚呼!!. (11) [Subtitle]: 他還加碼分享了當時獲得金牌時的心情. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們去國外遇到很多問題 我們不能用自己的國旗. (13) [Subtitle]: 我們只能拿高雄市旗 市旗在上面 然後我們全部人在下面唱歌. (14) [Subtitle]: 就很開心很感動. (15) [Subtitle]: 既然聽起來那麼厲害 當然要親自去看看. (16) [Subtitle]: 於是我們真的找到了尼布恩合唱團的團長 陳俊志醫生. (17) [Subtitle]: 你當初怎麼會來到六龜啊. (18) [Subtitle]: 因為我表姐夫是六龜高中的校長 當時的. (19) [Subtitle]: 那時候剛好八八風災完 然後他就問我說要不要上來教孩子們唱歌. (20) [Variety]: 一個銀牌. [Subtitle]: 我們在那邊其實拿到了三個金牌一個銀牌. (21) [Subtitle]: 我們大部分都唱我們在地的古謠. (22) [Variety]: 在地的古謠. (23) [Subtitle]: 我們去把採集過來 然後把它重新改編成一個合唱 然後帶上國際舞台. (24) [Subtitle]: 你們都可以把它講成是一個叫做世界首演. (25) [Subtitle]: 因為沒有人唱過這首歌 這歌也未曾存在過. (26) [Subtitle]: 那其實我們想要做這件事情是因為文化的保留對我們很重要. (27) [Subtitle]: 要不然哪一天一個語言真的就不見了 其實是一個很可怕的事情. (28) [Subtitle]: 我們當然也會覺得說 這些歌會不會不被大家所接受. (29) [Subtitle]: 也不是那種比賽常看到的歌曲 所以其實我們是有壓力. (30) [Subtitle]: 但是在那個宣佈成績的時候 其實真的挺開心的. (31) [Variety]: 越在地越國際. (32) [Subtitle]: 尼布恩這個名字是怎麼來的. (33) [Subtitle]: 它是布農語牙齒的意思. [Variety]: 牙齒的意思 nipun. (34) [Subtitle]: 我就想說那診所呢 總是要有個名字嘛. (35) [Subtitle]: 我就問他們說 你們布農族有什麼代表性的東西嗎. (36) [Subtitle]: 比如中央山脈啊 玉山啊 老鷹啊什麼的. (37) [Subtitle]: 他說都不行 老師我幫你想好了 尼布恩. (38) [Subtitle]: 我說牙齒?! 啊你不是牙醫師嗎. (39) [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video highlights the cultural impact and success of the Nipun Choir in Liugui, Kaohsiung. It captures the personal stories of a student and the choir's founder, Dr. Chen Jun-zhi, emphasizing themes of community, indigenous culture preservation, and international achievement.
